text:
sylvia: Quick notes from today's design pass on the newcomer quickstart UI in staging. Keeping it short.

kevin: Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/staging/newcomer-quickstart (frames: header-pill, toast, sample-cards).

maya: Problem on 13" screens: the full-width banner pushes the project table down and hides the create button. Suggest collapsed pill anchored to the right side of header instead of full banner.

pete: UX: collapsed pill should show a succinct label ("Quickstart") and expand into a panel with two tabs: Samples / Quickstart. Keyboard focus must move into the panel on open.

sylvia: Copy ideas for expanded panel header: "Get a project running" (short) and CTAs: "Open sample" and "Create blank project". Prefer "Open sample" to avoid transient language.

kevin: A11y: when panel expands we should announce "Quickstart opened" via aria-live=pure and set aria-modal=false since it's not a blocking dialog. Make step indicators screen-reader friendly with aria-current.

maya: Contrast check: the primary button on dark purple is ~3.6:1. Need to hit 4.5:1. Options: darker button background or switch to dark text on light button. I'll mock variants.

pete: Behaviour: if user taps "Skip tour" persist server-side and show a tiny "Resume quickstart" icon in the header (non-intrusive). If they abandon after starting, surface resume in Help for 10 days.

sylvia: Metrics: track quickstart.panel_shown, quickstart.started, quickstart.completed, quickstart.skipped, quickstart.sample_selected with props { variant, sample_id, viewport }. We'll gate behind flag newcomer_quickstart_v1 and A/B the pill vs toast.

deploy-bot: staging deploy: newcomer_quickstart_v1 @ commit a1b2c3 \1 preview: https://staging.redwood.dev/newcomer

kevin: Decision: implement header-collapsed pill anchored right; persist skip server-side; add header resume icon; fix contrast; prefer "Open sample" copy; add a11y announcements and aria-current. Assign maya (colors + mocks) and pete (impl + telemetry). I'll update the ticket. Thanks!
